name: obs-lmdeploy-metrics-loggers
notes: The LMDeploy MetricsLogger. Same metric names and same vLLM bucket-building idiom (build_buckets / build_1_2_5_buckets) but two divergences worth knowing: lmdeploy:iter_token_latency has no _seconds suffix, and there is no preemption metric at all - grep for 'preempt' in this file returns nothing.
